text:
Nadia Brooks: quick triage for Verdant private/VPC onboard - two fail states: KMS access denied in CI and our audit-forwarder not connecting to their SIEM over private link. can we run checklist?

Evan Li: saw `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied` in their pipeline. usually policy principal mismatch or missing ExternalId on AssumeRole. did they share role ARN and trust policy?

verdant-ops: sharing role arn: arn:aws:iam::700011122233:role/verdant-ci-role and trust policy shows AssumeRole from our account only, no ExternalId.

Kara Thompson: if their role expects an ExternalId we need them to include it in the assume call or remove the condition. ask them for the exact assumeRole call logs (CloudTrail).

Nadia Brooks: pasted their KMS key policy (snippet) into ticket - principal is correct (role ARN) but there is a Condition on `aws:SourceAccount` equal to their account. that should be fine cross-account but we should confirm our request isn't using an assumed session that changes source account header.

Evan Li: also note Verdant rotates keys nightly. if they rotated and didn't add our role after the rotation, CI fails intermittently. ask for key rotation timestamp and if they used automatic rotation.

verdant-ops: rotation is automatic at 02:00 UTC. last rotate 02:05 today. they confirm role ARN is present in new policy.

Kara Thompson: next, audit log delivery: our forwarder attempts mTLS to logs.verdant-sec.internal -> 10.200.6.7:443 but we get TLS alert `unknown_ca`. looks like their SIEM uses private CA. options: customer provides CA bundle for onboarding test, or they issue a cert from a public CA. security-bot will need an approval ticket for adding CA to trust store.

security-bot: Policy: temporary customer CA can be added for up to 72h with CS ticket and security approval. Record will be required: ticket ID, CA fingerprint, start/end times.

Nadia Brooks: I asked Verdant which they prefer. also flagged renewal risk: onboarding is day 11 of a 14-day SLA; if unresolved in 36h escalate to AM.

verdant-ops: prefer temporary CA trust for cutover tests; uploaded CA bundle and signed access window in CS-7112.

Evan Li: for the KMS flakiness, please run `aws sts get-caller-identity --output text` from the CI job and paste CloudTrail assumeRole event. if ExternalId present, we'll advise how to include it in the CI assume call.

Kara Thompson: I added small onboarding change: require "AssumeRole example + sts get-caller-identity output" and "CA bundle or public cert note" to the private onboarding checklist. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboard (updated).

Nadia Brooks: pairing session scheduled 14:30 UTC to apply temporary CA and watch a test log flush. Evan will monitor KMS calls and Kara will coordinate the audit record. I'll update CS-7112 after the session. :white_check_mark:
